assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve animation sprite sheet. Create FOUR full-body Aria walking sprites in a 2 by 2 grid on transparent background. Image 1 defines Aria's exact identity, clothing, head-to-body proportions and warm illustrated style. Image 2 defines ONLY the four distinct walking leg phases in reading order; do NOT draw Leon or use his clothes. Keep Aria's head size, torso length, leg length and elevated three-quarter view facing screen RIGHT identical across all four cells. Top left: near leg (unstrapped thigh) reaches forward to right, far leg (strapped thigh) trails left. Top right: near leg plants under hip, far strapped leg swings forward slightly, knees pass. Bottom left: OPPOSITE contact, far STRAPPED leg reaches forward to right, near unstrapped leg trails left. Bottom right: far strapped leg supports under hip, near unstrapped leg swings forward slightly. The thigh strap is a fixed anatomical marker and must stay on the same far leg; do not swap it to cheat. Modest grounded steps, not high knees or kicks. Opposite arm swing; relaxed neutral attentive expression, no mouth changes. Same head vertical level within tiny walking bob, same boot scale. Blonde bob, lavender lock opposite white flower, green eyes, elf ears, cream blouse, green gold cape, leather boots. Generous transparent gutters, no cropping, no shadows, no props, no floor, no text. Four different phases, not the same lead leg repeated.
assets.review: Rejected: repeated far-leg-forward silhouettes, no passing poses.
